name: Dubai
tagline: Global MICE capital, mega conventions & futuristic luxury
intro: The premier global destination for high-capacity corporate conventions, automotive dealer launches, and luxury leadership conclaves.
access: Direct flights from Delhi, around three and a half hours.
highlights: Purpose-built convention infrastructure handles large delegate counts and complex staging without improvisation.
Fast visa processing and dense flight capacity from every Indian metro make large-group movement predictable.
Covers both ends of a programme: serious conference facilities and genuine reward value for an incentive trip.
planning_note: Summer heat from May to September pushes everything indoors and makes outdoor evenings unworkable. Rates also spike around major exhibitions, so check the event calendar before fixing dates.
